description: Returns ready texts, a resident email, a move-in text and email to forward to new tenants, desk card and move-in insert wording with the partner’s link, links to the partner’s printable move-in package (move-in insert and QR card PDFs with their own QR and code), plus the house rules for sharing (honest words only, no pressure, never ask residents for phone numbers or door codes).
